The company plans to issue up to 416,666 units at C$2.40 each. Each unit will include one common share and one transferable warrant, with each warrant exercisable at C$2.50 for 24 months.
The closing is expected on or about November 6, 2026.

The proceeds will be used for strategic capital markets initiatives, outstanding and future payables and indebtedness, corporate awareness and general working capital, while supporting the company's battery-metals exploration, rebalancing, and recycling strategy.
The new financing replaces the remaining portion of the company’s previous private placement. Battery X Metals
had already issued 259,367 units for C$713,261.45 in two tranches.

title: Battery X Metals launches up to C$1M private placement at C$2.40 per unit
